level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Sins Exposed
level_seven.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Fury
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level_one.title: Overwhelming Affliction
level_one.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Wailing Arrow
level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Widowmakers
level_one.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

level_four.title: Hexed Crawlers
level_four.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

level_seven.title: Spirit of Arachyr
level_seven.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

level_ten.title: Ravenous Spirit
level_ten.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ice Block
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Spider Colony
level_sixteen.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

level_one.title: Ranger
level_one.description: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

level_four.title: Everlasting Light
level_four.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

level_seven.title: Elune's Gift
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Lunar Flare grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level_ten.title: Starfall
level_ten.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Harsh Moonlight
level_thirteen.description: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Attunement
level_sixteen.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

level_one.title: Sulfuras Hungers
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25.  Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

level_four.title: Catching Fire
level_four.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.  Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

level_seven.title: Blistering Attacks
level_seven.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

level_ten.title: Lava Wave
level_ten.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

level_thirteen.title: Cauterize Wounds
level_thirteen.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Scorcher
level_sixteen.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Faerie Protector
level_twenty.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

level_one.title: Furious Blow
level_one.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level_four.title: Shattered Ground
level_four.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

level_seven.title: Poisoned Spear
level_seven.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Mystical Spear
level_thirteen.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slammer
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Composite Spear
level_twenty.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: Master Assassin
level_four.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spray 'n' Pray
level_thirteen.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level_sixteen.title: Armor Piercing Rounds
level_sixteen.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

level_twenty.title: Big Red Button
level_twenty.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

level_one.title: Extra-Wound Timers
level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Chattering Teeth
level_four.description: Steel Traps will slowly chase nearby enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Sticky Wicket
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: RIP-Tire
level_ten.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

level_thirteen.title: Gotta Trap 'Em All!
level_thirteen.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

level_sixteen.title: Endless Nades
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cannonball!
level_twenty.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level_one.title: Nerubian Armor
level_one.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

level_four.title: Bed of Barbs
level_four.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Chitinous Plating
level_seven.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Urticating Spines
level_thirteen.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Epicenter
level_sixteen.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_twenty.title: Rewind
level_twenty.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
